description: Free. Lock a filled form: draw every field's value and every comment into the page so nothing can be edited. Lock artifact_id, usually the filled PDF from fill_form: every field's value, checkbox and comment becomes part of the page, no fields stay editable, links keep working, and the original stays as it is. Returns the new artifact_id and a report: fields_locked, annotations_locked, pages, and calculated_left_blank (the labels of boxes the form totals itself that were empty). A locked form can't be read back or checked, so run read_form or verify_form first. Refuses a digitally signed PDF (pdf_signed) and a dynamic XFA form (xfa_dynamic).
name: flatten_pdf
title: Lock a filled form
